why_a_manifest_and_not_a_count: SG5 pinned this file's check COUNT (BASELINE_DRAWING_SET = 329, retired with this change).
A count is a scalar over a set: it cannot tell a check that VANISHED from a
check that was ADDED somewhere else. Measured over 46908c6..49502e5, that is
not hypothetical — 29 named checks disappeared in FOUR events, every one of
them masked by a larger increase, and the pin was green throughout.

method: drawing-set.test.mjs is byte-identical at all seven bisect commits
(md5 7e2e10ff1d5dd2aac9c771ede5e24c12), so every count change came from the
system under test and none from the test. Each commit was checked out into a

Each run's instrumented manifest length was reconciled against the count that
same run printed. All seven reconciled exactly.
but_its_arithmetic_is_NOT: The ledger recorded '26 checks lost in three events'. That summed NET deltas.
Measured by name: 19 + 7 + 1 = 27 lost across those three steps (the middle
step's -6 is 7 lost against 1 added), plus a FOURTH event the ledger records
as a clean +12 which is really 14 added against 2 lost. 29 checks vanished.
